Sugar Free Strawberry Jam
By: Carrie Barr
Published: Friday, December 11, 2009 - 12:11am

Ingredients




1 pint pt. strawberries
1 cup water
1 (4 serving size) envelope sugar free strawberry

Preparation

1 Crush strawberries and cook for two minutes in one cup of water. 2 Now, mix in one of the gelatin envelopes. Stir until completely dissolved. When cool, pour into three small jars: one for the refrigerator and two for the freezer.

About


Three calories per tablespoon.
